experimental_method: Static vapour-pressure cell with pressure transducer; 150 g solutions of known mass fraction measured from about 323 to 373 K in steps of about 5 K.
uncertainties_stated: u_w = 0.0001; per-point u_t (K) and u_p (kPa) printed; solute purity 0.99; transducer accuracy 0.08 kPa; leakage up to 1.016e-3 kPa/h over about 35 h.
quality_remarks: Authors state 121 data points; table holds 121. Their e-NRTL model deviates up to about 6 percent at w=0.3 and 0.5 CaCl2.
not_extracted_tables: Sections 2-3 of the SI: uncertainty equations and solution-enthalpy derivation (no measured table)

row_counts.Table S1: printed 121 data rows + 2 block label rows; written 121 + 2

extraction_notes: Only the SI is covered; the main paper is not in the PDF. Calculated columns (gamma_w, e-NRTL, Antoine) kept in the CSV, mapped as unmapped extras.
needs_pass2_reason: text layer clean and every cell matched the page images
